scenario.summary: Guest adds the bundle product with two checkbox add-ons selected on the PDP, then verifies on the cart that the line item lists the included products and the add-ons and that the unit price equals bundle price plus both add-on prices; removes all items.
steps: Search the bundle SKU and open the first result
Select two checkbox add-ons by name
Add to Cart and open the cart
Verify the line item description (included products and 'Checkbox : <add-on>' lines)
Verify unit price = bundle price + first add-on price + second add-on price
stateChanges: Guest cart: the bundle with two add-ons is added, then all items are removed
assertions: Line item description lists the included products and the two selected add-ons
Unit price equals bundle price + both add-on prices
evidence: Method name and comment: add-ons added with a bundle are shown on the cart.

selectAddOnOptionOfTypeCheckbox clicks the add-on by its name, so the two names are data: AddOnFirstProduct -> addOnName, AddOnSecondProduct -> addOn2Name (the key's first two add-ons of display type CheckBox, in display order), their prices FirstAddonPrice -> addOnPrice, SecondAddonPrice -> addOn2Price. The sheet pair is GE Pro 6-Outlet ($11) and 8-Outlet ($23); any two add-ons of the resolved bundle serve.
BundleProductPrice '500' -> product.price (effective unit price); the test sums it with the two add-on prices.

Gap risk: minAddOns counts add-on associations (groups), not add-on products; the test needs at least two products in CheckBox groups. A fallback bundle with one checkbox add-on product has addOn2Name null and the test cannot select a second add-on.

AddOnBundleProduct is composed: 'Qty: <childNBundleQty> | <childNSku> - <childNName>' per child, then '<addOnGroupName> : <addOnName>' and '<addOnGroupName> : <addOn2Name>' (group label 'Checkbox' on the recorded bundle); data without output, built by the migrated test.
Profile (Playwright observations): z-1234579 is an active BundleProduct in PRODUCTION; the Playwright bundle PDP entry shows three checkbox add-ons on it.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
